agent_wakeup_requests_company_idempotenc.name: agent_wakeup_requests_company_idempotency_key_uq
agent_wakeup_requests_company_idempotenc.where: idempotency_key is not null and reason in ('max_turn_continuation_retry', 'issue_monitor_due', 'finish_successful_run_handoff')

agent_wakeup_requests_dedup_key_queued_u.name: agent_wakeup_requests_dedup_key_queued_uq
agent_wakeup_requests_dedup_key_queued_u.where: status = 'queued' AND dedup_key IS NOT NULL

execution_workspaces_active_task_workspa.name: execution_workspaces_active_task_workspace_uq
execution_workspaces_active_task_workspa.where: source_issue_id IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'archived'

execution_workspaces_active_thread_works.name: execution_workspaces_active_thread_workspace_uq
execution_workspaces_active_thread_works.where: thread_id IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'archived'

issues_open_routine_execution_uq.name: issues_open_routine_execution_uq
issues_open_routine_execution_uq.where: origin_kind IS NOT NULL AND status NOT IN ('done', 'cancelled')

notifications_retry_queue_idx.name: notifications_retry_queue_idx
notifications_retry_queue_idx.where: delivery_error IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NULL
